name: Touring the Grounds
summary: Breton asks you to walk the grounds of Bandarion Keep after the murloc attacks come under control. Meeting the keep’s leader, Danitha Morr, is your first step toward settling among its residents.

sections.title: At the Keep
sections.body: Breton asks you to meet the residents of Bandarion Keep and look around the stronghold. Once you have finished, Danitha Morr can help you settle in. The keep is still small, but its people call it home.

sections.title: A Commander
sections.body: Danitha Morr introduces herself as the closest thing the keep has to a commander. She welcomes those who seek fellowship with people still loyal to the Light, and says the keep needs help before it can be fully established.

faq.q: Who is asking me to look around?
faq.answer: Breton encourages you to explore Bandarion Keep after the murloc attacks come under control.
Danitha Morr is the closest thing Bandarion Keep has to a commander.

faq.q: Why should I speak to Danitha Morr?
aliases: where do i go after touring
faq.answer: Danitha Morr can help you get settled in among the keep’s residents.
It is a small stronghold whose residents call it home.

faq.q: Who is welcome at the keep?
faq.answer: Danitha welcomes those seeking fellowship with people who remain loyal to the Light.

attribution: In-game quest text: Touring the Grounds
